outputs.explanation: Panel A shows bar graphs of mean ± SD band intensity for HMGB1 in nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fractions across three genotypes (N=4), but only the mean and error bars are plotted; the individual data points underlying each bar are not shown.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron microscopy images, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a western blot image showing bands from different purification methods, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a western blot image demonstrating proteinase K protection, not a plot of averaged data.
